Today at school, Miss Chang’s students talked about the jobs they wanted to have when they grow up. Kenya, Wendy, and Gavin wanted to be artists. Hugo and Seema wanted to be farmers. Taylor wanted to be a dentist. Each student seemed excited, except for Stella.

slides.text: Ever since she could remember, Stella has always wanted to be a doctor so she could help people. However, Stella is quite squeamish. If she sees needles or blood, her face turns a palish color, and she does not feel well.
